grammar.summary: 本课描写砸橱窗抢劫，集中运用过去完成进行时强调「抢劫前一直在做」的布置与动作，并用 with 复合结构（with its headlights on）渲染场面，同时以 too...to（太……而不能）表现窃贼抢钻石的专注。

points.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous)
points.explanation: had been + 现在分词，表示到过去某时刻为止一直在进行的动作，强调延续。本课用 had been working busily since eight o'clock 说明店员「从8点起一直在忙碌布置」，直到抢劫发生前刚刚完成。

examples.en: Two of his assistants had been working busily since eight o'clock and had only just finished.
examples.cn: 他手下两名店员从早上8点就开始忙碌，这时刚刚布置完毕。

points.title: with 复合结构 (with + object + complement)
points.explanation: with + 宾语 + 宾补（形容词/副词/分词/介词短语）作状语，表示伴随状态。本课用 with its headlights on and its horn blaring 描写大轿车「亮着前灯、响着喇叭」冲进街道，画面感强。

examples.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its home blaring, roared down the arcade.
examples.cn: 宁静突然被打破，一辆大轿车亮着前灯，响着喇叭，呼啸着冲进了拱廊街。

points.title: too...to 太……而不能 (too...to...)
points.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to do，表示「太……以至于不能做某事」，to 后不定式含否定意义。本课用 too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain 说明窃贼「忙着抢钻石，连疼痛都顾不上了」。

examples.en: One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue, but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.
examples.cn: 一个窃贼被一尊很重的雕像击中，但由于他忙着抢钻石首饰，竟连疼痛都顾不上了。

exercises.q: Two of his assistants ______ working busily since eight o'clock and had only just finished.
The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its home ______, roared down the arcade.
he was too busy helping himself to diamonds ______ notice any pain.
用过去完成进行时填空（写出助动词部分，两个词）：Two of his assistants ______ ______ working busily since eight o'clock.
The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed. 中 for 的用法是______。
